offering_description.value: Ridgepost Capital offers private equity, venture capital, private credit and impact investment strategies to institutional and private investors. Its investment managers pool capital in funds and build portfolios through fund commitments, secondary purchases and direct investments.

primary_products.value: private equity funds; venture capital funds; private credit funds; impact investment funds

primary_services.value: private markets investment management; customized portfolio management

customer_segment.value: B2B: private pension plans, endowments, foundations, financial institutions and family offices; B2G: public pension systems; B2C: high-net-worth investors

end_markets.value: institutional investment; retirement systems; private wealth management

revenue_model.value: commissions or management fees: ongoing fees for managing funds and portfolios, plus carried interest on eligible investments

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: pools investor commitments and allocates capital to private funds and companies; service provider: builds and manages customized private market portfolios for institutional investors

geography_served.value: global: North America and Europe, with investors in other regions

specialization.value: related lines: private equity, venture capital, private credit and impact investing

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: fundraising and investor relations teams working with institutional allocators and private investors

regulatory_exposure.value: high: investment adviser registration and private fund oversight under SEC and applicable foreign securities rules

notes: Size is estimated relative to private markets asset managers.
